name: The majority voted in favour of [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-03-28.349.3), which means they'll now be included in the bill. They were introduced by ACT Senator [David Pocock](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/david_pocock) (Independent). ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 21, page 17 (lines 6 and 7), omit “5 years”, substitute “4 years”.* > > *(2) Clause 91, page 57 (lines 2 and 3), omit “within 5 years after the commencement of this section”, substitute “by 31 December 2026”.*
